correctness.rationale: For circular white-noise STFT with g_s=sqrt(1-s)h0+sqrt(s)h1, 0<=s<=1, the two-point Kac–Rice coalescence expansion reduces contact to one quarter of p_(F,F_u)(0,0) times the conditional square of Im(conj(F_uu)F_v). The Hermite ladder yields explicit derivative linear forms in four independent circular Gaussians. Orthogonal conditioning on F=F_x or F=F_y gives opposite Jacobian signs and the exact axis limits 2s^3(4+7s-8s^2)/(1+2s)^2 and 6s^4/(1-2s+4s^2)^2. Independent complex Gaussian Gram-Schur regression and fourth-moment evaluation agreed at s=0,.05,.2,.5,.8,1, including 0 and 2/3 endpoints. This verifies finite-dimensional Gaussian algebra; the limiting Kac–Rice dominated-convergence lemma and nondegeneracy away from s=0 are analytic inputs, not finite-experiment conclusions.
